title: How I built a multi-school ERP on one codebase
summary: Separating each school's data safely while sharing one backend and one frontend.
body:
## The problem

Every school wanted its own system, its own branding — and ideally its own app. Building one system per school wasn't realistic.

## The approach

- **One database, tenant-scoped data.** Every record belongs to a school, and every API query is filtered by that school's ID.
- **Roles on top of tenants.** Super Admin, school Admin, teacher, student and parent each get different permissions, enforced in middleware.
- **One frontend, many apps.** The same React/Vite build is packaged with Capacitor into branded Android apps, each with its own name, logo and application ID.

## What I learned

Design tenant separation in from day one — retrofitting it later touches every query.
